commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Verona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+2' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Rafik Belghali (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' One of the Verona players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
87' The game has come to an end for Andrea Pinamonti. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo).
85' Substitution. Giovane (Verona) makes his way off the pitch and Grigoris Kastanos comes on as his replacement.

75' Verona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
71' 0 - 1 Goal! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
71' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the centre of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Lorenzo Montipo who easily stops the effort.
71' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is going to take the penalty!
71' Referee Francesco Fourneau is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Sassuolo!

68' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
68' Giovane (Verona) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Roberto Gagliardini as he is replaced by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona).
65' Sassuolo keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
64' Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
63' Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
63' Sassuolo are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
62' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
61' There's a break in play and referee Francesco Fourneau must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Sassuolo using VAR. This could be interesting!
61' A player from Verona takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Aster Vranckx is replaced by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo).
59' Here is a change. Armand Lauriente is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
59' Substitution. Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) has come on for Cristian Volpato.

59' Giovane (Verona) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Arijanet Muric pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
58' Some neat passing and movement from Verona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

45+3' The end of the first half.

45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) hits a dangerous effort towards the roof of the net from the promising free kick. His shot is stopped by a well prepared Lorenzo Montipo.

43' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Giovane (Verona) who directs his shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to stop his effort.
42' Giovane (Verona) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Arijanet Muric anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
41' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

40' Wasted opportunity! Suat Serdar (Verona) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
38' The ball is cleared after Rafik Belghali (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' Martin Frese (Verona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Martin Frese (Verona) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him.
36' A player from Sassuolo commits a rough challenge. Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Verona are awarded a free kick.
35' Referee Francesco Fourneau has finally had enough of Fabio Grosso and brandishes a yellow card at him!
34' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
33' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes.
32' Antoine Bernede (Verona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Verona.
27' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) sends a long ball in, but Lorenzo Montipo comfortably gathers the ball.
27' Sassuolo players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
27' The ball possession is 64:36.
22' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
21' Some great controlled play and passing from Verona. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' Giovane (Verona) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
18' The Verona players are stunned as referee Francesco Fourneau changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
16' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Verona using VAR. Let's see what happens.
16' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) handles the ball inside the penalty area. PENALTY to Verona! Let's see who will take responsibility.
15' Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
12' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
10' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
9' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

6' A nice pass finds Giovane (Verona) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the bottom right corner, but Arijanet Muric pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
6' Verona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game. One of the players from Sassuolo won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
